guidance.goal: Thank the Mayor of Jerusalem for the city bike lanes and share how much fun the monthly community bike ride of the ABI cycling group (Bicycles for Jerusalem) was.
guidance.stance: We support bike lanes in general and enjoy the monthly community ride and want to thank the city for both.
guidance.tone: Polite, short, respectful and thankful. Written by a real resident in their own voice. No threats, no insults, no pressure tactics.
guidance.length: One to three short sentences, up to about 250 characters.
guidance.language: Write in the requested language. No commas, periods or line breaks (they are removed anyway).
guidance.factsNote: No verified facts are published for this topic yet. State no figures, dates, street names or claims beyond goal and stance. Do not invent facts.
